data.title: Coins mark King Rama VI
data.description: <p>The Treasury Department is preparing to issue commemorative coins marking the 100th anniversary of the death of King Vajiravudh (Rama VI), Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.</p>

data.title: 'Phuket Eyes' to keep cars in check
data.description: <p>Phuket Provincial Police have reported progress in the rollout of an AI-powered surveillance network designed to improve public safety and tackle traffic problems across the island.</p>

data.title: The chaotic saga of Kanye West's planned Russian concerts
data.description: MOSCOW - From the announcement of his concerts last week to a venue backing out days later, US rap star Kanye West's two planned shows in Russia have captivated the country, with officials divided about whether they should go ahead.

data.title: Driven by distraction? Trump steps up stunts as US midterms loom
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - From trolling Canada about a lake to suddenly talking about Kim Jong Un, US President Donald Trump's recent distractions speak louder than words.

data.title: Klongthom Center fire under control, building partly collapsed
data.description: The well-known Klongthom Center of tools, electronic devices, car audio systems and accessories, toys, models and home appliances started to collapse after hours of burning on Friday night. Fire was put under control afterwards.

data.title: Greenland to open truth commission over forced contraception scheme
data.description: COPENHAGEN - Greenland said Friday it would establish a Truth and Reconciliation Commission on Denmark's forced contraception of thousands of indigenous Inuits, after experts failed to agree on whether the scheme constituted "genocide".

data.title: The missing in Nepal-Tibet flash floods
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - More than 2,400 people were still missing Friday missing and 584 were confirmed dead after flash floods and landslides hit the Nepal-Tibet border.

data.title: Fire breaks out at Khlong Thom Centre
data.description: A fire broke out on Friday night at the Khlong Thom Centre, a popular multi-storey market known for auto parts, tools, electronics and vintage goods in Bangkok.

data.title: Police summon ‘Aunt Da’ again over temple trespass
data.description: Khon Kaen police have issued a second summons for a 62-year-old woman known as “Aunt Da” to acknowledge a trespassing charge after she failed to respond to an initial summons for blocking an entrance to a temple earlier this month.

data.title: Celine Dion arrives in France for comeback shows
data.description: PARIS - Canadian superstar Celine Dion arrived in Paris on Friday two weeks ahead of the first of her sold-out comeback concerts in the French capital.

data.title: No easy way out of three-airport rail deal, says Anutin
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul says he expects there will be no easy road for a CP Group-led consortium to exit the dormant three-airport rail project by terminating the deal.

data.title: Thieves buy tickets before robbing Vienna museum
data.description: VIENNA - Two men bought tickets to enter Vienna’s Museum of Applied Arts (MAK) before smashing a display case, grabbing a 200-carat platinum and diamond necklace and walking away, police said on Friday.

data.title: Nepal flood trauma ‘enormous’, says Red Cross
data.description: GENEVA - The Nepal-Tibet flood disaster has left an “enormous” level of trauma, the Red Cross said Friday, with early estimates suggesting 93,000 people may have been affected.

data.title: PhD medical student scammed out of B11 million
data.description: A PhD medical student has fallen victim to a call-centre scam gang posing as a mobile phone company employee and a police officer, who duped him into transferring money and handing cash to their accomplices, resulting of losses of 11 million baht over three days.

data.title: ‘We ran for our lives’: Harrowing tales from Nepal
data.description: NUWAKOT, Nepal - Some survivors of the deadly floods on the Nepal-China border ran for their lives, others narrowly missed disaster, but all were eyewitnesses to a major calamity and its aftermath.

data.title: Swiss nuclear plant back online after heatwaves
data.description: GENEVA - The Beznau nuclear power plant in Switzerland, which was shut down multiple times over the last two months due to summer heatwaves, is fully operational again, the Swiss energy company Axpo said on Friday.

data.title: Arkitektura wins prestigious Master Entrepreneur Award at APEA 2026
data.description: Another milestone for Arkitekturaon the Asia-Pacific stage, reflecting the strength of its leadership in driving the organisation forward under the philosophy “It’s all about quality,” while fostering sustainable growth and delivering value to customers,businessesand society.

data.title: Body found in aircraft wheel well in Kuala Lumpur
data.description: The body of an unidentified person has been discovered in the wheel well of an aircraft at Kuala Lumpur International Airport Terminal 2 (KLIA2), Malaysian authorities said.

data.title: Iran says it’s still open to diplomacy
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran left the door open to diplomacy on Friday, six months into a war with the United States that has upended the Middle East, but only if Washington abandons its pressure campaign.

data.title: Monarchs, world leaders mourn Norway’s King Harald
data.description: OSLO - European monarchs and world leaders paid tribute Friday to Norway’s King Harald, after the royal palace announced his death at the age of 89.

data.title: Nepal-China floods: Latest developments
data.description: KATHMANDU - More than 1,400 people are missing and at least 552 have been killed after a devastating, tsunami-like wall of water gouged a path through the border region between Nepal and Tibet, sweeping away entire villages.

data.title: Revamped MasterChef Asia returns
data.description: The revamped reality competition MasterChef Asia is set to premiere on HBO Max on Sept 22, as well as TLC and Discovery Channel on Sept 22 and 23, respectively.

data.title: Guru's Weekly Buzz: Aug 28-Sept 3
data.description: Guru By Bangkok Post's weekly pick of the most exciting products, activities, food and travel to indulge in.

data.title: Moonlight Silver Forum 2026 Introduces “The Next Benchmark”
data.description: Moonlight Bullion Refinery Co., Ltd. highlights a pivotal shift in the silver jewelry industry, as competition across the Global Jewelry Supply Chain moves beyond quality, pricing, and manufacturing capabilities toward “The Next Benchmark” — a new competitive landscape increasingly shaped by Responsible Sourcing, Traceability, Transparency, Certification, and Sustainability. In response to this transformation, the company is hosting “Moonlight Silver Forum 2026,” bringing together industry leaders and businesses to exchange perspectives, anticipate emerging standards, and strengthen their readiness to compete in an evolving global market.

data.title: Bangkok’s sacred Lakshmi Shrine and Varalakshmi Vratam
data.description: Nestled high above the bustling luxury of the Ratchaprasong intersection, Bangkok’s spiritual heart is home to a unique cluster of sacred shrines dedicated to nine revered deities.

data.title: ZTE and AIS Launch ZTE Day Thailand 2026 to Drive Intelligent Networks
data.description: ZTE and AIS launched ZTE Day Thailand 2026,showcasingintelligent network solutions to accelerate Thailand's smarter, more sustainable digital transformation

data.title: Pi Securities hosts AI-era investment seminar
data.description: Pi Private Wealth ,a part of Pi Securities Public Co Ltd (“Pi Securities”) , hosted the “Navigating Your Portfolio in the AI Era: 2H 2026”seminarunder the theme “How to Build an Investment Portfolio in the AI Era”. The event provided insights into the economic outlook and key investment strategiesfor the second half of 2026, with a particular focus on the opportunities and challenges arising from artificial intelligence, the digitaleconomy and related industries. The seminar also explored practical approaches to portfolio construction, asset allocationand risk diversification, equipping investors with strategies to navigate rapidly evolving market conditions and capture opportunities in the AI-driven investment landscape.
